info.title: RealAdvisor Inbox API
info.description:
Shared mailbox API backed by Neon Postgres.

## Authentication
Hosted documentation uses Cloudflare Access browser login. API calls accept a verified browser session or an inbox API key. Requests from this page use your existing same-origin session. All allowed users can access registered live mailboxes. Only designated mailbox administrators may create them. Local development is synthetic and loopback-only.

## Automation / n8n
Create a key in Settings → API keys. Send Authorization: Bearer inbox_…; no Cloudflare service-token headers are needed after the API path is configured for application authentication. Keys are restricted to selected mailboxes and mail:read, drafts:manage, mail:send, conversations:manage webhooks:manage, classifications:read, classifications:review, classifications:run, folders:manage and agent:use permissions. Agent access also requires mail:read and each tool respects the granted scopes. Send email is opt-in. Keys cannot manage people, settings or other keys. Administrators manage keys using their browser session.

## Mail identities
Each registered name@ingest.realadvisor.com mailbox sends as name@realadvisor.com. Public-address forwarding from Google Workspace is configured separately.

## Interactive requests
Requests execute against the current origin. Sending, modifying and deleting affect real data on the hosted instance. No external request proxy is used.

post.description: In live mode, only users listed in MAILBOX_ADMINS can create mailboxes, and creation must be enabled. The email must use ingest.realadvisor.com, with a 1–64 character lowercase local part containing letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or number; consecutive dots are forbidden. Case is normalized to lowercase. Registration and system folders are committed atomically. Existing addresses return 409. The shared routing rule immediately permits this registered inbox, and sending uses the matching @realadvisor.com identity. Google Workspace/Groups forwarding for the public address is a separate step. Local synthetic mode remains unrestricted.

get.description: Page-based pagination. Query searches subject, sender, recipient and body as a literal substring. Filters combine with AND. date_start is inclusive; date_end exclusive. threaded=true returns the latest matching email per thread. Mail arrival can shift page boundaries; deduplicate workflow processing by email UUID. Tags are returned on every message. Tag filtering never joins duplicate assignment rows into the result.

401.description: Missing or invalid authentication; the Access edge may redirect anonymous browsers to login.

post.description: Sends real mail in live mode. Caller supplies recipient, subject and body, including quoted/forwarded content if desired. Replies retain the thread; forwards start a new one. Store one UUID per logical send and reuse it with identical content on retry. A reused key with different content or a pending/unknown delivery returns 409. A provider ambiguity returns 502: inspect delivery before attempting another send. sent means provider acceptance, not final delivery. Local mode returns simulated and sends nothing. API keys require mail:send and access to this mailbox. Sender precedence is explicit sender_identity_id, saved draft identity, reply recipient match, then workspace default. Ambiguous or unavailable senders return 409; unauthorized live senders return 403. API keys must have access to both the conversation and sender mailboxes. From and Reply-To use the selected public identity.

422.description: Draft intent rejected before delivery. Keep unsaved text, reload and reopen the draft. The code draft_intent_conflict identifies this rejection. In live mode, rejected_request_id is returned only after idempotency lookup confirms that exact key has no persisted outbound attempt; clients may release that key. Existing sent, sending or unknown attempts take precedence and do not return this proof. Other 409/422 errors are not such proof.

post.description:
Start a resumable classifier backfill.

Administrator only. Returns immediately after saving all selected tag runs atomically. The server snapshots matching conversations and admits at most 500 outstanding evaluations per classifier, in pages of 100. Archived mail is included by default. Missing/outdated mode preserves current evaluation keys and human decisions. All forces a fresh evaluation at this run’s timestamp while sharing identical inputs within the run. An active selected classifier returns 409; no partial runs are created. Does not enable automatic assignment. Cancel through the existing classifier cancel endpoint.

get.description:

Returns every active run plus all tag runs from the ten most recent batches. Counts are per conversation/tag evaluation; reused is a subset of processed and unchanged a subset of skipped. Preparing runs have prepared=false and no final total yet.

post.description:

Read-only. Counts matching conversations once, including current and protected results; the worker reports actual skipped/reused counts after starting. Mail may change between preview and snapshot.

Check Typesafe credits and resume Jev.

Administrator only. Sends one synthetic Jev request while work remains paused. A valid successful response resumes the queue. Concurrent requests are fenced by a 60-second lease; a later HTTP 402 keeps the queue paused. An already active provider is a no-op.

Administrator only. Save configuration first. Iterate bounded pages using the returned cursor, fingerprint and before timestamp. Apply requires the preview fingerprint. Counts represent classifier/group decisions. Human decisions, stale results, technical failures and unavailable answers are preserved. Each page commits atomically; previous pages remain applied if a later page fails.

tags.description: Active tags on this mailbox/conversation; shared by every message, including replies and archived messages.

draft_version.description: Opaque version of editable draft fields. Send the version read from the draft to reject stale edits with HTTP 409.

sender_identity_id.description: ID returned by GET /api/v1/sender-identities. Explicit choice overrides the saved draft, reply recipient match, and workspace default.

draft_mode.description: Saved draft intent; null for legacy drafts with unknown intent. Legacy drafts send as new messages without reply headers.

draft_source_id.description: Internal source email ID in the same mailbox, separate from RFC In-Reply-To. Retained when source is deleted; sending then fails until a new draft is composed.

sender_identity_id.description: ID returned by GET /api/v1/sender-identities. Explicit choice overrides the saved draft, reply recipient match, and workspace default.

draft_id.description: Use the saved draft sender when sender_identity_id is omitted. Draft must belong to this mailbox. Sending does not delete the draft. Saved mode/source govern threading; legacy unknown intent requires explicit draft_mode=new confirmation.

draft_mode.description: Optional confirmation of saved draft intent. Must match explicit persisted intent when supplied. For legacy drafts whose intent is unknown, only the generic emails endpoint with draft_mode=new is allowed after informing the operator that sending starts a new conversation. Legacy reply/forward requests, missing legacy confirmation, or mismatched intent return 422 before delivery; preserve unsaved text, reload, and reopen the draft.

SendInput.description: A nonempty html or text body is required. Maximum 50 recipients across To, Cc and Bcc. From and Reply-To are fixed by the mailbox. No attachment uploads.

sender_identity_id.description: ID returned by GET /api/v1/sender-identities. Explicit choice overrides the saved draft, reply recipient match, and workspace default.

in_reply_to.description: Legacy internal source alias. Alias-only new drafts retain unknown intent. Does not infer reply/forward intent; supply draft_mode and draft_source_id. Old ambiguous send requests require reload/reopen and explicit review.

draft_mode.description: Explicit intent. New drafts default to new; saved intent is immutable. Replies and forwards require draft_source_id.

source.description: Current write endpoints always record manual.

actor.description: Verified Access email or local-synthetic-user. Never client supplied.

revision.description: Required on update; optimistic version from GET classifiers.

include_reviewed_examples.description: Use up to six recent human-labeled snapshots from the same mailbox and question as Jev examples. Defaults to false on create; omission preserves the value on update. Does not rerun completed classifications.

id.description: Available model ID from the model catalog. Workers AI IDs start with @cf/; gateway IDs use provider/model.

selectable.description: Available and its provider is configured

DecisionRules.description: Post-response decision thresholds. No must be strictly below Yes. Omitted values use defaults. Choice must pass confidence, winning probability and margin; insufficient evidence always needs review. Score uses score_boundaries to select a level and confidence to require review; probability and margin do not apply to Score.

score_boundaries.description: Score only: one strictly increasing boundary per gap, below the maximum level index. Equality selects the higher level. Defaults to midpoint boundaries.

limit.description: Omit to select all matching conversations.

tag_id.description: Only conversations currently carrying this active tag. The matching set is frozen for all classifiers when the run starts; manual protections still apply.

mailboxId.name: mailboxId
mailboxId.description: Mailbox address. Live mailboxes: privacy@ingest.realadvisor.com and info@ingest.realadvisor.com. URL-encode path values.

AccessSession.name: CF_Authorization
AccessSession.description: Verified Cloudflare Access browser session; human membership and roles apply. Do not copy session cookies to integrations.

InboxApiKey.description: Created by an administrator in Settings → API keys. Scope and mailbox restrictions apply; revoked or expired keys return 401.
